product_metadata.title: Exclusivo Mezcla Plush Extra Large Fleece Throw Blanket for Couch,Bed and Sofa (50x70 inches, Mint Green) Soft, Warm, Lightweight
features: Fuzzy Fleece: The fabric we choose is originally made from 100% microfiber polyester and brushed to create extra softness on both sides. Enough weight to keep you comfortable, yet light enough to keep you from breaking out in sweat. And the improved antistatic finish will effectively improve the situation of statics.
Extra Large: Compare with standard size ones, this throw blanket measured by 50x70 inch suits better for you to wrap up. No more worries about your toes.

Versatile: This premium throw is a very useful item to have on hand, it can protect your sofa/chair from dust and stain, keep you warm and cozy for a nap or movie time. Perfect size and weight to carry with for both indoor and outdoor activities, suitable for all seasons.

Decorative: This fuzzy fleece throw features a velvet touch of softness and double-faced plush look, it is designed to be simple but elegant which would easily coordinates or enhances existing bedding or home décor.
Easy Care: No need to spend special effort, it is machine washable and dry-able and would hold up well after washing. No shrinkage, No colour fading, and No unravelling.
